document_id.description: Unique identifier assigned to the document in the knowledge base.

title.description: Canonical title or heading of the legal document.

source_name.description: Registered name of the source publisher or agency.

source_url.description: Original web address / URL from which the document was retrieved.

source_domain.description: Fully qualified domain name of the source (must match a trusted registry entry).

authority_tier.description: Hierarchical authority tier assigned to the source (1 = highest).

authority_score.description: Initial design score representing relative authority.

jurisdiction.description: Legal jurisdiction relevant to the document (e.g., India, State of Delhi).

act_name.description: Name of the parent Act if applicable; nullable for standalone judgments or notifications.

section_number.description: Section or clause number if applicable; nullable.

chapter.description: Chapter number or title if applicable; nullable.

judgment_date.description: Date of judicial decision (YYYY-MM-DD); nullable for non-judicial documents.

publication_date.description: Official publication or enactment date (YYYY-MM-DD); nullable if unknown.

retrieval_date.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the document was downloaded/ingested.

language.description: Language code of the document content (e.g., en, hi).

file_format.description: Original file format of the ingested document.

original_file_name.description: Filename of the raw file as downloaded into data/raw/.

content_hash.description: Cryptographic hash (SHA-256) computed over raw file content for deduplication and audit integrity.

processing_status.description: Current status of document in the processing pipeline.
